map.心肌标志物动态判读（时序展示与辅助判读，非剂量公式）：cTnI/cTnT 发病: Cardiac marker dynamic interpretation (timing display and assisted reading, not a dosage formula): cTnI/cTnT rise 3–6 h after onset, peak at 10–24 h and persist 7–14 days; CK-MB rises 3–8 h, peaks 12–24 h and recovers 48–72 h (useful for detecting reinfarction); MYO rises 1–2 h, peaks 6–8 h and recovers 24 h. The 99th-percentile upper reference limit (URL) is used as the cutoff; a 0/3/6 h series showing a rise plus fall, or a delta (>20% of the URL change within 1 h), suggests acute myocardial injury.

map.心肌标志物动态判读（时序展示与辅助判读，非剂量公式）：cTnI/cTnT 发病: Cardiac marker dynamic interpretation (timing display and assisted reading, not a dosage formula): cTnI/cTnT rise 3–6 h after onset, peak at 10–24 h and persist 7–14 days; CK-MB rises 3–8 h, peaks 12–24 h and recovers 48–72 h (useful for reinfarction); MYO rises 1–2 h, peaks 6–8 h and recovers 24 h. The 99th-percentile upper reference limit (URL) is the cutoff; a 0/3/6 h rise-then-fall pattern suggests acute myocardial injury. The delta hint threshold of 20% of the URL is a page estimate (not a universal diagnostic standard) and requires clinical review.
